algorithmsSubtitle: A collection of mainstream ML algorithms — plug & play for Agent tasks
verticalModelsSubtitle: Fine-tuned on enterprise data, transforming general AI into business-specialized reasoning engines
selectAgentDesc: Select an agent instance from the sidebar to start a conversation
authFailedDesc: Could not resolve the current user. Click retry; if it persists, refresh the page or sign in again.
agentOfflineDesc: Agent is not online. Please make sure acp-link is started.
autoStartDisabledDesc: Auto-start is disabled for this instance. Enable it in the instance config, then retry.
maxSessionsReachedDesc: The instance limit has been reached. Stop another instance first, then retry.
launchSpecBuildFailedDesc: The instance launch configuration is incomplete. Check the environment and execution settings, then retry.
environmentUnavailableDesc: The agent environment no longer exists or has been deleted. Go back and select an agent again.
machineUnavailableDesc: The remote machine hosting the agent is unavailable. Verify the machine is online, then click reconnect.
instanceIdleReclaimedDesc: The Agent instance was reclaimed after being inactive. Click reconnect to start it again.
clientKeepaliveTimeoutDesc: The connection was closed after keepalive timed out. Click reconnect to resume the conversation.
agentRequestFailedDesc: The operation did not complete. Try again; the connection is still available.
reconnectingDesc: Connection lost, reconnecting automatically. Click retry if it does not recover.
wsSendFailed: Connection lost — the operation was not sent. Wait for reconnect or click reconnect.
restartDescription: Select instances to restart. Configuration changes require a restart to take effect.
configSavedRestartDescription: Configuration has been saved. Agent instances need to restart for changes to take effect. Restart now?
deleteAgentConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete agent "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
